description: Additions to a parent faction, which may come from another source in the same game

__schema0.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support; ignored by Force Org

tags.description: keywords and sub-types, matched by `tag:` references and profile filters

modelCount.description: models in the unit as bought for its `cost`; with `composition`, the sum over its blocks of `min` × models per copy

additionalModels.description: up to `max` more models at `cost` each, of no particular profile; not used with `composition`

composition.description: how many models of each profile the unit holds and how it grows, as blocks of models bought together; replaces `additionalModels`

id.description: needed for upgrades, default wargear and sub-faction rules to point at the profile

template.description: a unit stat template id from the game

stats.description: stat id → value, checked against the template

type.description: replaces the unit's type for this profile

tags.description: added to the unit's tags for this profile (e.g. Sergeant)

swapFrom.description: each pick of any option takes `count` (default 1) of this wargear off the upgrade's profile (or the unit at large), up to what is held, besides giving the option's own wargear; covers options reached through a reference too, except options with their own `swaps`; not applied to the `default` option

options.description: own options and references to shared faction upgrades; when ids clash, the upgrade's own option wins, then the shared upgrade referenced first

items.description: Wargear a unit carries without taking any upgrade

traits.description: the unit's traits (e.g. a faction trait), matched by `trait:` references and selector `traits` as case-insensitive text; effects may add or remove some

when.description: when the unit may be taken

limit.description: how many of this unit a scope may hold, e.g. unique characters

__schema8.description: A plain number, or an expression that evaluates to one

__schema10.description: An expression in the Force Org expression language (docs/specs/expression_language_spec_2026-10-17.md)

items.description: A set of models bought together: the unit holds between `min` and `max` copies of it, e.g. a Gun Crew of one Gunner and one Loader

__schema13.description: shown to players, e.g. "Gun Crew"; left out, built from the profile names

__schema16.description: unique within the unit; the key a saved list stores the number of copies under

__schema17.description: profile id → how many models of it one copy of the block holds, e.g. `{ "gunner": 1, "loader": 1 }`

__schema19.description: copies in the unit as bought for its `cost`; left out = 1

__schema21.description: most copies the unit may hold; left out = `min`

__schema23.description: what each copy above `min` costs; needed when `max` is more than `min`

__schema24.description: each copy takes the place of models of `profile` in `block` instead of adding models, e.g. one Thallax upgraded to a Praetorian: the unit's size stays the same and the profile's count moves to this block's profiles

block.description: the block whose models it replaces

profile.description: the profile in that block each copy takes the place of; one model of it per model in the copy

__schema29.description: the profile that takes this upgrade's wargear; left out, the unit at large does

__schema31.description: id of the option picked by default

type.description: single: once for the unit or one model; multiple: any number of times; every: every model gets it; some: any number of models; one-in-x: one per `everyX` models

excludeProfiles.description: profiles not counted as models for this upgrade

__schema33.description: Picks profiles by their type and tags (the unit's included), matched as case-insensitive text. Left out, every profile is picked.

items.description: Wargear the unit must hold, optionally only counting profiles that match the filter

__schema40.description: Points at a faction weapon or piece of equipment

__schema43.description: sibling unit upgrades this upgrade takes the place of when picked

__schema45.description: caps total non-default picks at Σ count × amount of that wargear held

items.description: An upgrade may be picked `count` times for each of this wargear the unit has

__schema49.description: A rule's condition plus the player-facing reason shown when it isn't met

__schema51.description: id of the sub-faction unit modifier that added this upgrade

id.description: id of the option entry in the unit upgrade

target.description: id of the faction upgrade it pulls in

swaps.description: wargear this option replaces, wherever the profile got it from

subChoices.description: ids of shared sub-choices made with the option, e.g. a weapon's `mount`

effects.description: applied to the unit while the option is picked, e.g. armour plating raising armour

items.description: Takes one `from` off the upgrade's profile and gives it `to` in its place, per pick

__schema58.description: several stat changes sharing one profile filter

items.description: `add` shifts the number and keeps its suffix: '3+' -1 → '2+', '6"' +1 → '7"'

__schema66.description: changes the unit's traits (traits belong to the whole unit, so there is no profile filter); traits match as case-insensitive text

__schema70.description: traits the unit loses, if it has them

__schema72.description: the unit loses any of `from` and, only if it had one, gains `to`

__schema75.description: carried by every model, so the amount follows the unit's model count

__schema77.description: with `perModel`: profiles that don't carry it

__schema78.description: the profile that carries it; left out, the unit at large does. With `perModel`: one for each model of that profile

template.description: a weapon stat template id from the game, e.g. `ranged` / `melee`

additionalProperties.description: A faction-level upgrade units point at instead of repeating it

configurable.description: the rule takes a value, e.g. Deep Strike (X)

defaultValue.description: the value a configurable rule has when a selection gives none

grants.description: contingent resources a unit with the rule grants its contingent (negative takes some away). Expressions may use the `rule` scope, e.g. Quartermaster (X) `{ "reserve": "rule.value() - 1" }`

slots.description: slots each unit with the rule adds to its group, e.g. one filled from another faction

items.description: A slot a mechanic adds to a group

__schema89.description: the slot's role; with several the player picks one

__schema90.description: only matching units may fill the slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are the source's units

anyOf.description: A named selector by id, accepted wherever a `UnitSelector` is, e.g. `"@line-infantry"`

__schema92.description: Picks units by id, role, trait and profile type/tags; left out, a field matches every unit

__schema95.description: a unit matches when it has any of these traits, matched as case-insensitive text

__schema97.description: a unit matches when one of its profiles does (or the unit itself, if it has no profiles)

__schema98.description: a unit that matches any of these does not match the selector

items.description: Units to leave out, matched like a selector (its fields all apply); e.g. `{ "profiles": { "anyOf": ["Unique"] } }` leaves out every unit with a Unique profile

__schema101.description: Where a slot's units come from instead of the contingent. Units keep their own records (wargear, rules, upgrades) but not their home sub-faction's unit modifiers. The slot's `units` selector picks among them, seeing only each unit's own traits; the detachment's `units` doesn't apply

__schema102.description: a faction of the same game, possibly from another source; may be the contingent's own

__schema103.description: units of these sub-factions of `faction` may fill the slot too (`any` = every one loaded), whether or not the contingent took them; left out, only the faction's own units

__schema106.description: applied to the unit filling the slot, after the detachment's effects, e.g. replacing a borrowed unit's faction trait

type.description: a group type id from the game

roles.description: units of any of these roles may fill the slot

required.description: must be filled for the list to be valid (compulsory slots)

repeat.description: the slot may be added more than once, each copy holding one unit (a team's vehicles, optional slots); `max` left out = no limit

units.description: only matching units may fill this slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are the source's units
only matching units may fill any slot, including slots a mechanic adds, except slots with a `source`

requirementText.description: shown when a requirement isn't met

min.description: how many of this detachment a list must hold, e.g. a mandatory veteran formation

max.description: how many of this detachment a list may hold

effects.description: applied to every unit in the detachment, e.g. "Every unit in this detachment gains the Gun Line trait"

items.description: units the list must already hold before the detachment can be taken

__schema114.description: where they're counted: the detachment's contingent outside it (default) or its root group

items.description: applied to every unit in the detachment, including units in slots added later

additionalProperties.description: A selector with a name, referenced as `@id` from expressions and selector fields
A choice made for a slot with the option's tag, applying its effects to the unit in the slot (and the group), e.g. special benefits or enhancements. One option per tag per slot.

__schema121.description: offered on slots with this tag

__schema122.description: only offered on slots of these roles; left out = any role

__schema124.description: only offered on slots whose unit matches, seen as it stands before slot-option effects (its traits from option and detachment effects included), e.g. `{ "traits": ["Macrotek"] }` for an option only Macrotek units may take; left out = any unit

__schema125.description: added to the cost of the unit in the slot

oneOf.description: adds a slot to the group; with several roles the player picks one
units of these roles may also fill the slot

additionalProperties.description: A choice made alongside an option, defined once and shared by every option that offers it

costMultiplier.description: resource id → multiplier for the option's cost, e.g. a turret mount `{ "points": 3 }`

__schema133.description: list rules that apply to contingents using this faction (or sub-faction), e.g. a rule about this faction's own traits

oneOf.description: Caps what may be spent on matching units, e.g. heavy units 25%, allies 50%
Limits how many matching units (or groups) a scope may hold
Escape hatch for list rules no typed form covers. A rule only flags the list; it never prevents anything

__schema136.description: count only these units; left out = every unit

__schema137.description: count only units in contingents whose root group is one of these types

__schema149.description: `list` (default): the condition is checked once for the whole list. `group`: checked once for each group (of the listed `groupTypes`, or any) with `group`, `contingent`, `root`, `main` and `list` available; the message is reported for each group that fails

__schema151.description: with `scope: "group"`: only groups of these types

versions.description: A semver range a version must satisfy, e.g. `>=1.2.0 <2.0.0`

__schema155.description: one of the parent's `subFactionGroups`; left out, the `default` group. Sub-factions that can be taken together (different groups, or one group whose `max` may exceed 1) must not define the same record differently

__schema156.description: when the sub-faction may be taken, checked for the contingent it is taken for. Expressions may use `contingent`, `root`, `main` and `list`, e.g. `choice(allegiance) == traitor` or `main.is(subfaction:x)`

__schema157.description: records that intentionally replace the parent's (same kind and id); any other collision is an error

additionalProperties.description: A sub-faction rule applied to every unit of the parent (and sub-faction) it selects

oneOf.description: the matched units can't be taken (e.g. a sub-faction's banned vehicles)
